text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We received a report of damaged
floorboards
due to deteriorating
infrastructure.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Have a contractor stop by and give
us an
estimate to fix it. Brian, can you
make a sign to
alert any passing
students? Something simple is
fine.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just so we're clear, you're not getting
any help
from me this time! You're a
vice-president too, so
try to act like one!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm looking forward to the sign,
Brian. As
for me, I shall head over to
inspect the area. We
need to know how
bad the damage is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In order to properly convey to the
contractor the
degree of damage, we
need more eyes on the
ground... Hm?
Eyes on the... ground.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Eyes on the ground. Get it? It's
the floor!
Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: This isn't the time for jokes...
